summary: A 36-year-old man ducked a rope out of Steamboat Resort into the backcountry without a cellphone and failed to appear at a planned dinner; reported missing to Routt County SAR ~11 pm Monday. With no phone to locate him, rescuers waited for daylight; a Classic Air Medical helicopter searched Tuesday morning without success, then four Routt County SAR volunteers with ski patrol found him ~2 pm Tuesday stuck on steep terrain near the East Face backcountry gate at the Mt. Werner summit, having built a shelter overnight (summit low 3F). Ski patrollers carried him to the base; hospitalized with minor cold-related injuries.
location: East Face backcountry gate, Mt. Werner summit, Steamboat
responding_agency: Routt County SAR, Classic Air Medical, Steamboat ski patrol
notes: 2019-03-04 = Monday night call; found 2019-03-05 ~2 pm. Summarized from SnowBrains (parent-opened 2026-09-15 run 629).
